rules: A hold-out is a skill-guided scenario that no tuning of the skill, the grader or the help text used: one per transcript path, with an event that no scenario in scenarios/ or cold/ names, and truth read from the corpus manifest only.
Each file is frozen by the SHA-256 below. A change to a hold-out is made only together with its entry here, in the same visible diff, and never after the first counted run of a batch that uses it.
A hold-out that fails is a finding about the skill, never a reason to edit the grader or the scenario.
